breaking_news.headline: This is how close American households are to the financial edge
breaking_news.summary: A new report shows that nearly half of U.S. households did not earn enough to cover their necessities in 2024.

breaking_news.headline: FIFA's World Cup ticket sales outraged fans. Now they are under investigation
breaking_news.summary: FIFA has always had a peculiar way to sell tickets to the World Cup. It never faced any major issues — until prices soared for the 2026 tournament.

breaking_news.headline: CBS' Bari Weiss overhauls '60 Minutes,' fires top producer and reporters
breaking_news.summary: The new head of CBS News is flexing her muscles at the network's most storied news program: "60 Minutes." We look at the upheaval.

breaking_news.headline: Here's how we're coping with high gas prices, according to Costco and Walmart
breaking_news.summary: Sky-high gas prices have drivers going out of their way for discounts at the pump. Oil executives warn that even higher prices might be on the horizon.

breaking_news.headline: United Airlines flight to Spain pulls U-turn, apparently over Bluetooth device name
breaking_news.summary: The flight to Palma de Mallorca diverted back to Newark late on Saturday. Air traffic audio and social media posts indicate an onboard Bluetooth device raised security concerns.

breaking_news.headline: One by one, U.S. civil rights agency dismantles tools to fight discrimination
breaking_news.summary: The EEOC is seeking to overturn rules created decades ago to tackle discrimination in employment. The Trump administration says those rules have led to more discrimination —against white people.

breaking_news.headline: Remote work -- not AI -- has sidelined recent college graduates, research finds
breaking_news.summary: Research from the New York Fed finds that younger college graduates have been sidelined by remote work in recent years, as companies may be reluctant to hire those needing more training and mentoring.

breaking_news.headline: AI giant Anthropic prepares to sell stock to the public; files preliminary IPO paperwork
breaking_news.summary: The Anthropic IPO, and those of other AI-related firms like OpenAI, could be among the biggest in U.S. history.

breaking_news.headline: Trump administration will abide by ruling halting $1.8bn 'anti-weaponisation' fund
breaking_news.summary: The justice department says it  "disagrees strongly" with a court decision to halt the establishment of the fund.

breaking_news.headline: Sabrina Carpenter gets restraining order against man who showed up at her home
breaking_news.summary: The singer reported a series of "deeply alarming" incidents at her house to Los Angeles police.

breaking_news.headline: Denmark's Mette Frederiksen to form government after months of negotiations
breaking_news.summary: The leader of Denmark's Social Democratic Party is forming a centre-left coalition minority government, giving her a third term as prime minister.

breaking_news.headline: Why Myanmar president's India visit is being closely watched
breaking_news.summary: Myanmar is seeking to broaden diplomatic engagement after years of international criticism and isolation.

breaking_news.headline: Two people shot dead amid Kenya protests against US Ebola quarantine centre plan
breaking_news.summary: The US plan has sparked public anger and led to demonstrations near the site of the proposed treatment facility.

breaking_news.headline: Clashes continue in Lebanon despite Israel and Hezbollah accepting US partial ceasefire plan
breaking_news.summary: A cessation of hostilities between Israel and Hezbollah is seen as crucial to the peace process with Iran.

breaking_news.headline: Ukraine rescuers pull dead from rubble after Russian strikes kill 18 people
breaking_news.summary: An eight-year-old boy and a woman killed in a strike on an apartment block are among the dead, officials say.

breaking_news.headline: OpenAI let ChatGPT aid and abet mass shooters, Florida lawsuit claims
breaking_news.summary: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier alleges OpenAI and boss Sam Altman built a 'web of deceit'

breaking_news.headline: China goes after 'ghost kitchens' to rein in cut-throat food delivery apps
breaking_news.summary: The thousands of "ghost kitchens" - online shops that don't actually exist - have spooked Chinese consumers.

breaking_news.headline: How 'confused' AI rollout hurts firms and baffles staff
breaking_news.summary: Some firms are putting pressure on staff to use AI, but have not thought through their AI rollout.

breaking_news.headline: London Tube strikes go ahead after talks fail
breaking_news.summary: Members of the RMT union are on strike on Tuesday in a row over working hours, with further action planned for Thursday.

breaking_news.headline: Steph Curry signs with Chinese brand after Under Armour split
breaking_news.summary: Chinese firms have been vying to secure deals with big stars as they push to become global brands.
